title: Blockus Party
description:
Roll the dice, grab the stars, wreck your friends.

BLOCKUS PARTY is a loud, colourful digital board game for up to 10 players. Twelve shapely heroes race around nine themed boards collecting coins and stars, and every round ends in one of 55 frantic minigames. Grab a gamepad, or just pull out your phone, and find out once and for all who is the sharpest shape in the room.

9 BOARDS, EACH WITH ITS OWN TWISTPick your battlefield on the board select screen before every game.

• Homeland Meadow - a sunny village of windmills and ponds, perfect for a first game.
• Cosmic Realm - warp across the stars and face down the Master Block.
• Foundry Works - conveyor belts carry you forward while piston traps slam anyone caught underneath.
• Frostbite Peak - slide down ice runs, cut across the frozen lake and keep away from the yeti.
• Tidepool Cove - the tide floods the sandbar shortcut every other round, and giant clams gamble with your coins.
• Haunted Hollow - a wandering ghost spooks the coins out of anyone who lands beside it.
• Ember Peak - the volcano targets tiles every round, and geysers blast you down the path.
• Lost Temple - race the pack to a golden idol and swing across the ruins on vines.
• Sugar Swirl - a giant lollipop where Candy Rain pays out to whoever is standing on the sprinkles.
55 MINIGAMESFree-for-alls, team battles and head-to-head duels, from quick reflex tests to all-out brawls.

Action and Survival Lava Hopper, Meteor Dodge, Sumo Slam, Dodge Brawl, Hot Fuse, Laser Limbo, Boom Hills and Tightrope Trouble.

Team Showdowns Tug o' Blocks, Block Ball, Volley Blocks, Capture the Cube, Snowblock Siege, Payload Panic and Snowman Showdown.

Skill and Rhythm Beat Bop, Quick Draw, Putt Panic, Sky Dive, Rocket Race, Whack-a-Block and Balloon Breeze.

Strategy and Wits Bid Blitz, Gem Heist, Blockus King, Color Swapper, Block Memory, Blockus Maze and Block Paper Scissors.

Spooky and Strange hunt ghosts by lantern light in a pitch-dark manor in Lantern Haunt, or survive the Singularity Shell.

DRESS TO IMPRESSMeet Blockus, Spherus, Cuboidus, Star Hero and the rest of the 12-shape squad, then give your piece a look all its own. Mix and match top hats, crowns, cowboy hats, propeller caps and halos with googly eyes, shades, monocles and mustaches, and finish the outfit with a bow tie, scarf or medal. Googly eyes wobble, propellers spin and halos glow as your piece hops around the board.

PARTY YOUR WAY• Up to 10 players on one screen
• Use your phone as a controller, no extra gamepads needed
• Host games for friends online or across your local network
• Smart CPU opponents fill any empty seats
description_short: Roll the dice, grab the stars and wreck your friends in BLOCKUS PARTY, a board game for up to 10 players. 12 shapely heroes, 9 boards with their own twists, 55 minigames and a closet full of hats. Play with gamepads or use your phone as a controller!
